definitions: To make smaller or less in amount, degree, or size.
To bring someone or something to a lower or weaker state.
To boil a liquid so that it becomes thicker and more concentrated.
To simplify a mathematical fraction by dividing by a common factor.
examples: The shop decided to reduce prices.
We must reduce our carbon footprint.
Simmer the sauce to reduce it.
Reduce the fraction to its lowest terms.
